create_bigquery_service: create a BigQuery service object by authenticating with Google Cloud application default credentials
create_bigquery_dataset: create a new BigQuery dataset in a specified project using the BigQuery service object
create_bigquery_table: create a new BigQuery table with a given schema and description in a dataset
create_partitioned_bigquery_table: create a partitioned BigQuery table with day-level partitioning and a 30-day expiration policy
insert_rows_bigquery: insert a list of rows into a BigQuery table using the insertAll API method
